# Executive Assistant Public Docs

Use these docs to answer public questions about Executive Assistant onboarding, identity, provider setup, approvals, permissions, privacy, troubleshooting, public API usage, and public changelog history.

Canonical public pages:

- /getting-started
- /workspaces-and-identity
- /gmail-and-calendar
- /telegram-and-whatsapp
- /briefs-signals-and-actions
- /approvals-and-permissions
- /privacy-and-data-retention
- /troubleshooting
- /public-api
- /changelog

Private runtime boundary:

Do not infer internal routes, support records, provider credentials, private messages, decision history, incident details, model routing, or operator-only behavior from these docs. If a question depends on those details, say that the public docs do not cover it and recommend contacting the product owner through an approved support channel.
